title: summary_snapshot holds the state lock ~340 ms scanning and projecting every session's metadata
outcome: immutable_state_snapshot_locked captures only cheap immutable inputs for the session-summary projection under StateInner and does that projection's per-session scan, projection, serialization and hashing off-lock, by extending the existing immutable-cut/cache owner from w-de6021f4b32f rather than adding a parallel cache, with snapshot/delta ordering and revision cuts unchanged. The test-run history projection's session traversal is carried by w-c4a13cdf08cf. Synchronous action-response snapshots and the stopped-mailbox fallback built by snapshot_from_inner are carried by w-089221790b26.
acceptance: Under the state lock, building a summary snapshot no longer scans, projects, serializes or hashes every session's summary metadata and queue identities for the session-summary projection; it captures immutable shared inputs (or reuses validated cached projections) and the per-session work runs after release, through the existing immutable-cut/cache owner. The test-run history projection's session traversal (TestRunHistoryProjection) is outside this item and carried by w-c4a13cdf08cf. Synchronous action-response snapshots and the stopped-mailbox fallback built by snapshot_from_inner are outside this item and carried by w-089221790b26.

Tests show the materialized StateResponse is equal to the current implementation's for representative states, including cache-hit, cache-miss and concurrent-mutation cases, and that snapshot/delta ordering, revision cuts and cache validation are unchanged.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: summary_snapshot and commit-path state cuts no longer project session summaries under StateInner. A cut captures the header, copy-on-write session rows and a projector handle under the lock. Captures queue in capture order, and the first consumer projects every live earlier capture in order through the unchanged single-slot summary cache, after release, so Arc identity and diffs match under-lock projection. Full mutable session scans use read-only predicates, so a pending cut no longer deep-copies unwritten rows. Replaced or evicted snapshots are disposed off the producer locks within a bound of 4. The capture queue compacts dead entries amortized. Landed by Opus2 as a fast-forward of master 995515bc to 61072da8 after a clean round-4 review pair, Windows FULL test-92368790 PASS on the exact source_id, and an independent acceptance PASS (delegation-af5e3187). Follow-ups: w-c4a13cdf08cf (TestRunHistoryProjection under StateInner), w-089221790b26 (snapshot_from_inner action responses), and Lows w-551bcce1ce44 and w-f32a20ebec30. Install pending at Central; a restart is worthwhile at the coordinators' moment.
